name: Standard Pipeline
description: Backbone creation pipeline - creates graph model from top-level documents

stages.name: Download

agentTier.rationale: Downloading is a straightforward fetch operation with no judgment required

processHints: Verify source connectivity before starting bulk downloads

stages.name: Validate
stages.description: Validate downloaded data against source rules

agentTier.rationale: Validation applies predefined rules but may require interpreting edge cases

processHints: Review validation report for warnings, not just errors
Halt on schema violations; warn on missing optional fields

stages.name: Parse
stages.description: Parse validated data into structured format

agentTier.rationale: Parsing uses defined grammars but may need judgment for ambiguous input

chunkGuidance.splitStrategy: Split large source files into groups by module or directory

processHints: Group files by module hierarchy for coherent parsing
Check parse report for partial-parse warnings

stages.name: Transform
stages.description: Transform parsed data to graph nodes and edges

agentTier.rationale: Transform requires mapping domain concepts to graph structure; needs deep understanding

chunkGuidance.splitStrategy: Group by color or node type to maintain coherent transforms

processHints: Ensure node IDs are stable and deterministic across runs
Validate edge endpoints exist before creating edges
Follow hierarchical ordering: parent nodes before children

stages.name: Integrate
stages.description: Integrate transformed data into graph model

agentTier.rationale: Integration resolves conflicts and merges data; requires careful judgment

chunkGuidance.splitStrategy: Batch nodes by type; integrate sketch nodes before color

processHints: Always create a snapshot before integration (preActions enforces this)
Resolve duplicate nodes by merging, not overwriting
Process sketch nodes before color data

stages.name: Verify

agentTier.rationale: Verification requires understanding model semantics and judging issue severity

processHints: Check for orphan nodes (nodes with no edges)
Check for dangling edges (edges referencing missing nodes)
Verify color assignments are consistent with node types
Report but do not auto-fix issues; let human decide

stages.name: Report

agentTier.rationale: Report generation aggregates data; moderate complexity

processHints: Include summary statistics: nodes added/modified/deleted, edges added
Highlight any warnings or issues from earlier stages
Include timing information for performance tracking
